intro: Between April and August 2026, ZCyberNews covered 60 ransomware incidents, with LockBit, The Gentlemen, and ShinyHunters among the most frequently cited actors. High-severity events dominated the mix, with 44 reported as high and six as critical. The most referenced vulnerabilities included CVE-2026-1731, carrying a CVSS score of 9.8, alongside CVE-2026-34197, CVE-2024-55591, CVE-2025-32433, and CVE-2025-33073. Affected sectors spanned healthcare, manufacturing, financial services, and government, with reports noting impacts across Global, North America, Europe, the United States, and Turkey.
